QUOTE: Deny is checked here, after approval. Deny wins over allow and over `auto_approve`, because an allow match alone never reaches the server.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes two gates, with an approval/allow gate in ToolExecutor::check_approval as well as the deny check. It never concludes that deny is the only blocking list consulted in ServerManager::execute. It says the opposite: that default-deny at gate 1 also blocks calls.
